gateway/CLI watchers deliver native completion; Desktop receives normal gateway stream while connected
native synthetic turn can run normal session handling; AOTA Profile Task is not wired into it
native backend restores pending completion rows; Desktop client has no event replay cursor; AOTA outbox remains pending but reconnect drain is deferred
no cross-profile state.db route or native ownership proof
